items.q: His son -- his name was Samuel Walker And, he was a terrific trumpet player, so he had this group

ctx.x: Yeah. And started you reading music a bit?

Yes. Yes. And, then there was a group called the Nighthawks in Charleston, and the trumpet player's father was one of the teachers at Jenkins'. His son -- his name was Samuel Walker And, he was a terrific trumpet player, so he had this group -- let's see -- trumpet, -- drums, -- saxophone, I think, -- piano. Four pieces I think it was. And, they were getting ready to do some dances at a place called Darts Hall.
